text: Modals: a close button and Esc everywhere; Esc in a textarea first only leaves the field
description: Felix 2026-11-23: "project settings (and similar modals) need an escape button and maybe support esc to quit (asking when in textarea to prevent vim habit close)". Space settings had neither: its capture-phase blockLeakage listener stopped every key at window, so even its own Esc handler never ran.

status.comment: composables/useModalEscape: one window listener, Escape goes to the topmost open modal wherever focus is; keys a control handled (preventDefault) are left alone; a modal with closeOnEscape false blocks the ones below. In a textarea/contenteditable the first Escape blurs and the header says "Esc again closes"; the second closes (through the modal's own discard prompt when it has unsaved edits). FormModalShell uses it and has an X in the header (HookLoops' own X removed); Space settings got Esc + X, and the redundant blockLeakage listener went (the app's shortcuts already stand down via isModalOpen), which also revives its inputs' own key handlers; ConsistencyModal got Esc. Evidence: FormModalShell.spec (Esc from anywhere, textarea two-step, topmost only / hidden skipped, closeOnEscape false + X) 5/5; ConnectionDetails, IdeaEdit, IdeaCreation, PhaseCreation and HookLoops Escape specs updated to the document-level handling; frontend 478/478, vue-tsc clean. Not tried by hand in the browser.
